# GetAudioBusVolume <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetAudioBusVolume:Float32 bus:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bus` | In | Int32 | required | A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), or `0` for the master bus. Anything else is a runtime error. |

**Returns:** The volume right now, `1` for a new bus.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Tells the volume of a bus that [AudioBusVolume](AudioBusVolume) has set, or the one it has got to while it fades. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print GetAudioBusVolume(0)
```
